requirements.text: Implement ROR-23 only after exact ADR ROR-24 acceptance and the Wave 1 gate. Define versioned MissionContract compiled from canonical specs/policies/approvals, mutable revisioned work packages under stable mission authority, execution leases with fencing/expiry/runtime identity/exact repository revision, and canonical immutable policy-definition plus scope-activation/checkpoint/receipt/bundle/delta/dispatch input provenance. Define normalized runtime-neutral execution/activity events, host-observed evidence envelopes, closeout/lifecycle decisions, cancellation acknowledgements, and plan-change proposals. PostgreSQL remains canonical; Git is code truth; Rorca memory is advisory; MCP is an optional generated projection, not federation protocol. Include migrations, API schemas, public-contract package, compatibility/versioning, authorization, idempotency, audit, threat model, and local DB-backed conformance tests. Preserve current SSDLC authority and executor behavior behind compatibility boundaries; deprecated ContextEpoch exists only as an exact read-only projection whose writes reject and whose removal gate is versioned.
